0022600196.text: The Bulls, now 1-7 and on a six-game losing streak, host the 76ers, who are 8-2, first in the East, and coming off a loss. Chicago trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 126-107 loss in Philadelphia on November 2, though the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring strain) and Zach Collins (illness), while Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (knee sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Adem Bona (back sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
